value.rationale: The original construction chooses a small arbitrary invariant ellipse without identifying the largest level on which the same infinite bisection itinerary is possible. Determining the full legal ellipse across all phases and all iterates gives a natural sharp extension of that mechanism, increasing the certified Q level by 63/2. The boundary has an exact first additional longest-edge tie and a universal square-root forbidden-block frequency above it, providing a meaningful local admissibility phase diagram and quantitative obstruction relevant to mesh refinement pattern design. These are not arbitrary single-point computations or recapitulated irrational-rotation facts.
